narrative_vs_numbers.summary: TCS has demonstrated exceptional execution in scaling its AI narrative into tangible numbers, growing annualized AI revenue from $1.5 billion to $3.1 billion within four quarters. However, management has consistently missed its aspirational operating margin floor of 26%, with margins currently stalled at 24% due to aggressive 'investments for growth' and subcontractor costs.

quarters.commentary: Management successfully delivered the promised turnaround in Manufacturing (3.1% growth) and sustained AI revenue scaling, though margins remained flat at 24%, failing to 'inch up' as previously suggested.

narrative_vs_numbers.pattern: Management maintains a conservative stance by refusing formal revenue guidance while providing optimistic directional commentary on vertical recoveries (e.g., Manufacturing and Life Sciences) which they generally deliver, albeit with a persistent lag in margin expansion.
